rv.q: Overall: it's a bloody good laugh. The secret is that it's based on other games that have very good fundamentals.
I can safely say I have never enjoyed an experience I have attended quite as much as I did this.
The Traitors: Live Experience is not just a cynical cash-in.

cn.t: Critics praise this immersive spin-off of the hit show as "massively fun," successfully translating the TV phenomenon into an engaging live experience, though participants should expect potential early elimination.
